messages:
maya_s: Heads-up — CloudAxis reported intermittent 502s when customers hit our marketplace listing -> partner infra. They've opened a SEV and asked for a clear handoff path. Can we define a short, repeatable flow for marketplace + HW partners?

samir: Noted. Do we already have a shared channel for CloudAxis? If not I can spin up a temporary war-room.

alex.k: :thumbsup: We have #partner-cloudaxis (private). For SEV I suggest creating a dedicated channel like `#sev-cloudaxis-<ts>` and auto-inviting oncall + partner leads.

jordan_pm: Quick proposal for the flow: 1) customer report -> marketplace triage -> 2) if infra/partner-related, create war-room & invite partner oncall -> 3) Redwood oncall joins + post runbook link -> 4) run mitigation & communicate externally. We should pin a 1-page handoff checklist.

maya_s: Agree. Roles to include: Redwood triage owner, Redwood oncall, Partner L2, Partner infra SME, and AM for customer comms. Also a clear handoff checklist so nothing is missed.

samir: Draft checklist items off the top: incident id, customer name & org, sample error + timestamps, request-id(s), region, immediate mitigation attempted, logs/location, who to contact on partner side, allowed troubleshooting window.

marketplace-ops: Can we standardize a war-room CLI? Example: `/warroom create sev-cloudaxis-1794512401 --private --invite @redwood-oncall @cloudaxis-oncall @maya_s @samir`

oncall-bot: Auto-ack: created channel `#sev-cloudaxis-1794512401`; joining...

alex.k: Also: make log collection automatic. Example command to pull a log bundle and post to the channel:

```
curl -X POST https://internal-logs.redwood/api/bundles \\
  -d '{"query":"partner=cloudaxis AND status=502", "since":"-1h"}' \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{REDACTED}}'
```

jordan_pm: SLA mapping idea: Tier A (critical customer impact) -> 15 min ack, 60 min mitigation plan. Tier B -> 1h ack, 4h plan. We should map marketplace listing incidents vs. partner-managed infra.

maya_s: Can we add a 'short-circuit' fallback: if partner doesn't respond within SLA, Redwood shifts traffic to an onboarded compatible instance (blue/green) to keep the customer online? Need an ops play for that.

samir: Yep — add fallback steps, who has permission to flip traffic, and required postmortem owner. I'll put a draft into Confluence and link it here.

cloudaxis-am: Thanks for the ping — I'm joining the sync. We'll confirm our oncall rotation and escalation numbers.

maya_s: Action items: samir -> draft handoff checklist by EOD; alex.k -> automate log bundle uploader (tomorrow); jordan_pm -> SLA matrix; I will contact CloudAxis AM to set expectations. Can folks join a quick sync at 11:15 PT?

alex.k: I can join.

marketplace-ops: :calendar: booked 20-min sync 11:15 PT and invited CloudAxis.

jordan_pm: For visibility: tag any SEV with label `partner:cloudaxis` and post a short summary to #partnerships-escalations for exec sync.

oncall-bot: Reminder: attach runbook https://confluence.redwood/partner-sev-template to the channel pins.

maya_s: Great — thanks everyone. Will pull the CloudAxis AM into the sync and share the Confluence draft once samir posts it.
_meta: generated for dataset: partner support escalation paths (marketplace + hw partners), single slack thread format
